finalText:
**94 files, 1082 hits.** Most of it is mechanical.

75 service files repeat one shape. 25 entities across 5 services.

Four places must not be renamed:

| Place | Files | Why |
|---|---|---|
| [docs/openapi.yaml](docs/openapi.yaml) | 1 | public contract, needs a new dated version |
| [lib/serialize.js:8](lib/serialize.js) | 1 | `WIRE` values are the frozen wire name |
| `migrations/*.sql` | 12 | applied history, editing breaks the down step |
| `vendor/reporting-sdk` | 4 | generated, wiped by `npm run vendor:refresh` |

Also 125 SQL column refs in repos. Those are the real DB column. And 25 `JSON.stringify` payload writes hold `account_id` in stored rows.

Next: split the code rename from the column rename.
